title: 第二十八章 三日清罗网，寸土不留邪
content_zh:
三日之约，弹指即至。

    整座京城在无声紧绷中度过第一日、第二日。

    萧聿辞手握全城兵权，调度雷霆，不留半分余地。

    禁军、巡防营、王府暗卫三线并行，依照此前锁定的暗阁潜伏点位，日夜清剿、层层收网。大街小巷、茶楼客栈、城郊荒院、河道码头，但凡藏有暗阁探子的角落，尽数被一一拔除。

    暗阁百年经营的京城眼线网，短短两日，土崩瓦解。

    往日混迹市井的陌生商贩、流民旅人，一夜之间尽数消失，悄无声息被肃清带走。没有喧哗动乱，没有血腥传闻，朝堂对外只字不提，百姓毫无察觉，唯有顶层权势与暗处势力知晓——

    百年暗阁，扎根京城数十年的暗线，彻底断了。

    相府汀兰院，成了这两日的临时运筹中心。

    沈清鸢端坐案前，手持清玄宗旧册，对照暗阁据点情报，逐一核对、查漏补缺。

    她熟稔暗阁惯用的隐匿手段、藏身习惯、传讯方式，那是母族代代相传、专门克制逆徒的记载，寻常朝堂之人根本无从知晓。

    也正因有她配合，萧聿辞的清剿行动才会快得如此彻底、精准、零疏漏。

    “西郊三处密道、城南河道水下暗桩、城东废弃钱庄夹层，这三处是暗阁最后的隐秘传讯点。”沈清鸢指尖点在图纸上，轻声道，“其余尽数作废，只剩这三处，还残留零星值守之人。”

    萧聿辞立在她身侧，低头看着图纸，眸色冷峻：“今夜子时，尽数拔除。自此，京城之内，再无暗阁眼线，再无他的耳目。”

    没了眼线，没了传讯，没了后手。

    那位隐于暗处的阁主，将彻底变成孤家寡人，空有百年声势，却在京城寸步难行。

    春桃站在一旁，看着连日并肩运筹的两人，心底安稳又紧张。

    安稳的是，王爷权势滔天、小姐智计无双，步步碾压暗阁布局。

    紧张的是，三日时限一到，便是真正的巅峰对峙，无人知晓结局。

    “小姐，暗阁阁主始终隐匿不出，连一丝踪迹都不露，他会不会另有诡计？”春桃忍不住问道。

    沈清鸢抬眸望向窗外沉沉夜色，淡淡开口：“他不急动手，是在等。”

    “等我慌，等我乱，等我自乱阵脚。他习惯操纵人心、摆布棋局，最擅长以静制动、以拖磨人。”

    可这一次，她不会慌。

    萧聿辞不会给她慌的机会。

    入夜子时，夜色如墨。

    王府精锐暗卫尽数出动，精准突袭三处最后的暗阁密点。

    不出半柱香时间，捷报尽数传回。

    暗阁最后值守之人全数伏诛，所有密信、残卷、传讯器具尽数收缴销毁。
content_en:
The three-day appointment is just a snap away.

    The entire capital spent the first and second days in silent tension.

    Xiao Yuci held the military power of the entire city and controlled the thunder without leaving any room.

    The three fronts of the imperial army, the patrol battalion, and the palace secret guards worked in parallel, and based on the hidden hidden points of the hidden pavilion that had been previously locked, they cleared the area day and night and closed down the nets layer by layer. Streets and alleys, teahouses and inns, deserted courtyards on the outskirts of the city, river docks, every corner where secret agents were hiding were all removed one by one.

    The Beijing eyeliner network operated by Ange for a century fell apart in just two days.

    The strange traders and homeless travelers who used to hang out in the market all disappeared overnight and were quietly purged and taken away. There was no noise and turmoil, no bloody rumors, the court did not mention a word to the outside world, and the people were unaware of it. Only the top powers and the forces behind the scenes knew——

    The century-old secret pavilion, the hidden thread that had been rooted in the capital for decades, was completely broken.

    Tinglanyuan of the Prime Minister's Mansion became the temporary operations center for these two days.

    Shen Qingyuan sat in front of the case, holding the old records of Xuanzong of the Qing Dynasty, comparing the information on the dark pavilion strongholds, checking them one by one, and filling in the gaps.

    She is familiar with the concealment methods, hiding habits, and communication methods used by the Ange. These are records passed down from generation to generation by the mother clan to restrain rebels, and ordinary people in the court have no way of knowing.

    It was precisely because of her cooperation that Xiao Yuci's purge operation was so fast, thorough, precise and without any omissions.

    "Three secret passages in the western suburbs, underwater piles in the river in the south of the city, and the mezzanine of an abandoned bank in the east of the city. These three places are the last secret communication points of the secret pavilion." Shen Qingyuan pointed his fingertips on the drawing and said softly, "The rest are all scrapped. Only these three places are left, and there are still a few people on duty."

    Xiao Yuci stood beside her, looking down at the drawings with a stern look in his eyes: "At midnight tonight, we will eradicate them all. From now on, there will be no Ange spies or his eyes and ears in the capital."

    No more eyeliners, no more subpoenas, no more backhands.

    The master of the pavilion who is hiding in the dark will become completely alone. He has a century-old reputation, but is unable to move forward in the capital.

    Chuntao stood aside, looking at the two people who were planning side by side for days, feeling reassured and nervous in her heart.

    What is safe is that the prince is powerful and the young lady is unparalleled in wisdom, crushing the secret pavilion layout step by step.

    The nervous thing is that once the three-day time limit is up, it will be the real peak confrontation, and no one knows the outcome.

    "Miss, the master of the dark pavilion has never been able to hide, without even a trace showing up. Could he have another conspiracy?" Chuntao couldn't help but ask.

    Shen Qingyuan raised her eyes to look out the window at the dark night, and said lightly: "He is not in a hurry, he is waiting."

    "Wait for me to panic, wait for me to be confused, wait for me to get into trouble. He is used to manipulating people's hearts and arranging chess games. He is best at stopping people with silence and dragging them down."

    But this time, she won't panic.

    Xiao Yuci would not give her a chance to panic.

    At midnight, the night is as dark as ink.

    All the elite secret guards of the palace were dispatched to accurately attack the three final secret points of the secret pavilion.

    In less than half a stick of incense, all the good news came back.

    The last person on duty in the dark pavilion was all executed, and all secret letters, fragments, and communication equipment were confiscated and destroyed.
title_en: Chapter 28 Clear the net in three days, leaving no evil behind
